blocks.text: The daily challenge of real estate financial modeling

Your value lies in your ability to underwrite deals and interpret market trends. However, the reality of the job is often different. You spend hours navigating web-based portals for property data, cleaning CSV files, and answering emails. This context switching kills your momentum. When you move from a complex DCF model in Excel to a client email, you lose your train of thought. Lazur helps you stay in the flow by acting as your voice-controlled assistant.
How to use Lazur for real estate data preparation

Data preparation is the bottleneck. You have to aggregate information from disparate sources before you can even start building a model. Whether you use DealCheck or PropertyMetrics, the workflow is often fragmented. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask Lazur to summarize a research report or explain a specific interface element you cannot find. If you are stuck in a deep menu in Excel, ask Lazur to guide you through the process. It will wait for your click at each step, ensuring you do not miss a detail.
When you are deep in a model, do not reach for the mouse to find obscure settings. Ask Lazur where a specific tool is, and it will draw a circle around the button on your screen.
blocks.title: Stay in your flow

blocks.text: Managing email and communication with voice

Email management takes up roughly 2.24 hours of your day. Instead of typing every response from scratch, use the fn key to dictate your replies. Lazur handles the formatting for you, keeping your messages professional and clear. If you need to draft a quick update for a client, dictate the core points and let Lazur refine the text. This allows you to finish your communication tasks faster and return to your financial models.
The Mac stack for modern real estate analysts

Your Mac is a powerful tool for analysis. Most analysts now rely on a mix of web apps and desktop software. Keeping these organized is key. If you use SupaSidebar to manage your tabs, you can ask Lazur to help you find the right space for a specific deal. Remember that Lazur does not edit your files or click buttons for you. It provides the guidance you need to operate your own software more efficiently. Always check your firm's rules regarding the handling of client or proprietary data before using any AI tool.

faq.question: Does Lazur work inside Excel for Mac?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur sees your screen and can guide you through Excel menus or answer questions about features. It does not click buttons or edit your cells directly.

faq.question: Is my real estate deal data safe?
faq.answer: Lazur only looks at your screen while you hold the shortcut key. Screenshots and audio are sent to AI providers to answer your request and are never stored or used to train models.

faq.question: Can Lazur help with web-based underwriting tools?
faq.answer: Yes. You can use Lazur to ask questions about any web interface, such as DealCheck or PropertyMetrics, by holding ⌥ ⌘ to capture your screen.
